plate.description: The shared frosted-glass material (grain + dark gradient + blur; on macOS a see-through tint over native Liquid Glass with a light that follows the pointer). Text, stat, progress, kv and chart titles sit on it.

button.description: Buttons: primary, ghost, icon-only, yes/no, swatches, toggles, ripple and shine.

asks.description: Several yes/no questions answered in any order, then one Send: a single wake with every answer.

beatring.description: A circle visualizer: 64 RGB radial bars from @/beat bands, a core that pulses on the beat, and what is playing from @/media (the video card).

chart.description: Charts on a canvas (bar, line, donut, gauge, heatmap, ...). Drawing code lives in ui/charts/.

checklist.description: A tickable to-do list: a count and hairline progress up top, round checkboxes, clock-time badges, a coral ring on what is due. A tick answers at once, then runs the allowlisted tick-<id> action that stores the state as JSON.

nav.description: The shared navigation model for workbench parts: selection, tabs, back/forward at a shared-store path; entity lookup; the reference chip and status dot. No component of its own.

codeedit.description: The whole file of the open entity in Monaco (vendored): highlighting, VS Code keys, Ctrl+S saves. Opens and saves through allowlisted actions that read the card's persisted state; no engine path of its own.

explorer.description: A grouped, searchable list of entities (files, messages, goals...). A click opens the entity through the shared nav, so the other workbench parts follow.

flowmap.description: The whole entity graph on React Flow (vendored bundle with React and dagre): pan, scroll, zoom, minimap, drag nodes; click a node to open it through nav, the open one's links animate.

list.description: Rows of text, optionally clickable. wrap:true = a wide list that shows each row's full text.

stat.description: One hero numeral with a label, unit and optional needle.

paste.description: Numbered paste blocks to hand over in order: title, size, a Copy button (host-side on macOS) and a preview that opens on click.

layout.description: Flex layout: columns, rows, panels, spacer, divider, wing; right-aligned cards and the leftward flow.

fluent.description: The Windows 11 (Fluent) skin: style only, keyed off html[data-skin~="fluent"]. Restyles the plate, buttons, rows, badges, checklist, progress, asks, pastes and the card's own corner buttons; loads after them.

inspector.description: The workbench's editor pane: open tabs, back/forward, breadcrumb, then the selected entity's note, reference sections and code peek; every reference opens its entity.

issues.description: A problems panel: every entity whose status is not ok, grouped by level (broken, check), with its note as the reason; a click opens it through nav.

skyline.description: The day as a 2D city: one building per hour, as tall as its minutes, floors lit by category (cats, default study / video / games), a sun or moon over the current hour; buildings rise in and grow live from any per-hour data.

steps.description: An ordered route through entities (a user flow, a request path) on a rail; previous/next walk it through nav so the other parts follow each step.

timer.description: A small ring sprint timer: the arc fills toward the goal, elapsed time inside (seconds under it), end time below, one pause / resume icon. Counts on past the goal. State in the card data (start, paused_at, paused_ms), kept by opts.persist.

video.description: A 16:9 video player: a YouTube link or id plays in YouTube's embedded player, any other URL in a <video> with controls. Sizes are tokens.
